collection.title: Jeep Grand Cherokee 1993 to 1999 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Jeep Grand Cherokee 1993 to 1999 model requires a 20" wiper blade on both the drivers side and the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm, there is also the option of upgrading to the newer Retrofit style wiper blade.
